en: Steven
{player}! Funny, running into you out here. I've just come from the Weather Institute up the river.
Tell me, how are your Pokémon? Do you feel the two of you have grown stronger together since Granite Cave?
I'm heading on to Route 120 to look into something there. If you're passing, come and find me.
Fisherman
Ah, a fellow angler? A good rod makes all the difference, wouldn't you say?
Ha! I knew it the moment I saw you. Kindred spirits! Here, take this one. I've got a spare.
Cast it where the water runs and see what bites. The fish here pull harder than you'd think!
No? Then you've never felt a real bite on the line. Come back once you have.
Is the Good Rod treating you well? Bigger water means bigger Pokémon, remember that!
Rose
What a lovely battle. May I have your number? I'd like to share news of my flowers.
Register Rose in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Thank you. I'll call when they bloom.
Oh, that's a shame. Perhaps another time.
Dalton
Man, you rock! Let's swap numbers. I'll call when I've got a new song.
Register Dalton in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Sweet! Keep your ears open.
No worries. The music goes on!
